title: Collision Properties in Discrete and Continuous Time on Bounded-Degree Graphs
summary: We prove that, on every connected bounded-degree graph, the infinite collision property holds in discrete time if and only if it holds in constant-speed continuous time, and the same equivalence holds for the finite collision property. The proof is based on a pointwise comparison between the Green kernels of the synchronous discrete-time pair chain and the asynchronous pair chain obtained by Poissonization.
